messages:
Alex: Heads-up — booking extra APAC H100 slots for overnight inference smoke test. Need ~4 GPUs from 23:00-03:00 SGT. Anyone seeing quota headroom in asia-east1?
Mina: I can try to carve from the staging pool but need billing sign-off. @Jamal can you check vendor queue? :eyes:
Jamal: Vendor ops replied: standby 2 racks ETA tomorrow 12:00 SGT, likely 6 GPUs but not guaranteed. Pinged procurement for a soft-hold.
Sofia: We do have 2 spare ephemeral slots in uk-west we could borrow overnight if latency is acceptable. Telemetry can route and measure p50 quickly.
Alex: uk-west latency too high for this smoke test (we need <80ms p50). Prefer APAC. If APAC unavailable, let's shrink the perf test to 2 nodes and shorter seq.
OpsBot: Reservation request submitted: req-8943, status=awaiting-approval (link: https://infra.internal/req/8943)
Mina: Filed a quick terraform PR for a temporary quota bump (draft): https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/512 — includes billing tag and expiry 2024-12-01. @Alex can you review?
Alex: skimmed PR, left one minor comment on naming. will approve in 10m.
Jamal: Procurement just soft-approved until we confirm invoice CC. I've emailed vendor ops with tenant id and cc. ETA update in 30m.
Sofia: Adding a short-term telemetry alert to detect eviction spikes: rule=apac-demo-evict, window=5m, threshold=5%. Pushing the config in ~25m and will post the alert link.
Alex: Awesome. Plan: wait for vendor confirmation until 21:30 SGT. If no APAC slots by then, fall back to reduced test in-region uk-west is last resort. Thanks all :thumbsup:
